_meta.note: frozen expected values for scripts/frvp_fx1h_tests.mjs; 1h bars, max hold 240h

profile.name: basic_poc_bin2_va_richer_neighbor
profile.note: POC=bin2(30 of 80); richer neighbor bin1(25)>bin3(15) DOWN first, cum=55<56; then bin0(10)<bin3(15) UP, cum=70>=56; VA bins1..3 -> VAH=185 VAL=128.75 (lo=110 hi=185 w=18.75)

profile.name: va_tie_expands_up
profile.note: POC=bin2(30); nbrs bin1=20 vs bin3=20 TIE -> UP bin3 (cum50<66.5); k_hi out of range -> forced DOWN bin1 (cum70>=66.5); VA bins1..3 VAL=128.75. A DOWN-first tie rule would add bin0 (VA [0,3], VAL=110) — discriminator

profile.name: poc_tie_lowest_bin
profile.note: bin0==bin1==30 -> POC=bin0 (lowest-priced wins); forced UP expansion to bin1 (cum60>=46.9); VA bins0..1: VAH=147.5 VAL=110; POC price=119.375 (bin1 would be 138.125 — discriminator)

profile.name: uniform_spread_candle
profile.note: spread 40 over 4 bins (width 25) = 10 each; bins=[20,10,30,10]; total 70 target 49; POC=bin2; nbrs bin1(10) vs bin3(10) TIE -> UP bin3 (cum40); forced DOWN bin1 (cum50>=49); VA bins1..3: VAH=200 VAL=125

profile.name: zero_range_candle_single_tick
profile.note: same as basic but candle4 is a zero-range 1h candle (one tick) at 147.1875 = exactly the midpoint of bin1 [128.75,165.625): all 3 units go to bin1; totals identical to basic: POC=bin2, VA bins1..3
